notes: בְּקִרְבְּכֶם is split into a fused preposition-plus-noun *within* and the suffix's *you*, following rule 30's one-English-word test.
The single *the* of *the stony heart* goes to the present article on הָאֶבֶן under rule 29's fronting clause, not to the construct לֵב, and the rectum is rendered attributively under rule 28.
